thread:
Casey (Support): Escalation: GalaxyPay onboarding blocked during customer validation. Two things surfaced: OIDC token validation failures for a subset of users (401s) and search returning empty results after ingest. Customer is planning prod cutover next month. Can CS pick this up as high priority? INC-6120 https://tickets.internal/INC-6120 :warning:
Nina (CSM): Acknowledge. Which envs affected and what's the quick impact summary for account health?
Casey (Support): Staging and preprod. Errors: `oidc: invalid_issuer_or_aud, status=401` and embed pipeline: `vector_dim_mismatch expected=1536 got=1024` when indexing partner-submitted payloads. They used an older embed client via the integrator.
Rohan (CS Ops): Splitting owners: auth+token handling -> Eng, reindex/migration -> CS Ops. I can own the re-embed job and provide a one-click migration.
Nina (CSM): @Miles can eng triage auth? We need a stopgap and clear comms. Also capture renewal risk and timeline.
Miles (Eng): Quick triage: looks like OIDC metadata cache didn't pick up the IdP's new `audience` mapping after their config change. Mitigation: force metadata refresh for the tenant or accept a tenant-scoped legacy-audience flag temporarily. Ops command: `POST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/galaxypay/actions/refresh_oidc` with ops token. I'll run a refresh now. Hotfix ETA for graceful handling of audience aliasing ~3-5 hours.
Casey (Support): Ticket INC-6120 updated with sanitized logs and sample tokens. ticket-bot: status -> escalated to CS + eng.
Nina (CSM): Draft customer-facing note (short): "Hi Alex  we're investigating two issues impacting your staging validation: (1) intermittent auth errors for some users; (2) an embeddings format mismatch on ingest causing sparse search. Immediate: we'll force an OIDC metadata refresh and provide a migration script to re-embed your data. Auth mitigation expected within 3 hours; reindex plan within 24 hours. Request 30m sync in the next hour." Thoughts?
Tara (Renewals): Please flag renewal tracker: risk = Elevated until ingest verified. Add a one-line summary for buyer outreach.
Rohan (CS Ops): For embeddings, quick workaround: use our conversion utility: `embed-convert --src-dim=1024 --dst-dim=1536 --profile=galaxypay --batch=400`. I will prepare the job and estimate backfill ~5-7 hours depending on dataset size. Will offer overnight window.
Miles (Eng): We can also expose tenant-scoped toggle `accept_legacy_aud` while we roll the patch. Ops command to set toggle: `PATCH https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/galaxypay -d '{"flags":{"accept_legacy_aud":true}}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops>"`. That should stop 401s immediately for their staging users.
Nina (CSM): Internal comms plan bullets for handoff:
- Immediate: Force OIDC metadata refresh for tenant + enable legacy audience toggle if requested  owner: Eng (Miles)  ETA: 0-3h
- Short-term: Patch audience handling & add monitoring for IdP rotations  owner: Eng infra  ETA: 3-6h
- Backfill: Run embed-convert + reindex job  owner: CS Ops (Rohan)  ETA: 5-8h (overnight option)
- Customer sync: 30m within 1h  owner: CSM (Nina)
Nina (CSM): I'll schedule the 30m sync at 09:45am PT and send the note. @Casey attach sanitized logs and @Rohan share the migration job link once ready.
Casey (Support): Attached sanitized logs and sample failing token. :white_check_mark:
ticket-bot: INC-6120 comment added by Casey: "Escalated: CS + Eng. Suspect OIDC metadata cache + embed client schema mismatch. Artifacts attached."
Tara (Renewals): Added account health note: GalaxyPay  renewal status = Monitoring (escalation). Will update if the backfill is delayed.
Miles (Eng): Running tenant OIDC refresh now for `galaxypay`. Posting status update in ~8m. :rocket:
Rohan (CS Ops): Building migration script + one-click job. Will post runbook link here when uploaded.
Nina (CSM): Thanks team. I'll own comms and cadence until resolved. If anything regresses after the toggle/refresh, ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
